capacity8.ci_method: 95% t interval across paired seed means; scenario families averaged within seed
capacity8.independent_unit: seed, not decision, agent, or family
capacity8.risk_definition: incorrect reserves / all reserves (zero if no reserves; inspect coverage)
capacity8.regret_definition: reserve while available=2, defer while disrupted=6, verify=1.5; otherwise 0
capacity8.correction_definition: local direct contradictory observation to next agreeing decision; non-recovery reported separately
